estimands.outcome: cardiovascular death or first hospitalisation for heart failure
estimands.missing_data_model: time-to-first-event Cox on the randomised population; censoring at last assessment

harmonisation_rule.harmonised_endpoint: CV death or first HHF -- the REGISTERED PRIMARY of BOTH EMPEROR-Reduced and EMPEROR-Preserved, identical two-component definition (neither counts an urgent HF visit). Endpoints already coincide; no cross-definition harmonisation needed.
harmonisation_rule.source: both trial registrations (verbatim outcome titles stored per trial)

eligibility.population: adults with chronic heart failure (NYHA II-IV) and elevated natriuretic peptides, across the ejection-fraction spectrum

statistics.tau2_estimator: REML (fixed-effect inverse-variance at k=2; Q=0.28, tau2=0)
statistics.small_k_ci_rule: k=2, tau2=0: fixed-effect inverse-variance z interval on the log scale

disclosure_clause.text: AUTHORED 2026-09-06, RETROSPECTIVE. The correct k=2 pool of the two registered PRIMARY two-component HRs is HR 0.7708 (0.700-0.849). External cross-check: the published EMPEROR-Pooled patient-level IPD analysis covers the SAME two trials, a same-trials method cross-check NOT independent evidence; a truly independent external does not exist. Method chosen on methodological grounds, not to hit a target.

external_crosscheck.name: EMPEROR-Pooled (same-trials IPD)
external_crosscheck.note: value to verify; same trial set -> disclosed cross-check, not independent
